ORDINANCE XXXIX OF 1984
ORDINANCE XXXIX OF 1984
EVACUEE TRUST PROPERTIES (MANAGEMENT AND DISPOSAL) (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1984
An Ordinance to amend the Evacuee
Trust Properties (Management and Disposal) Act, 1975
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 21st August, 1984]
Whereas it is expedient to amend
the Evacuee Trust Properties (Manage ment and Disposal) Act, 1975 (XIII of
1975), for the purpose hereinafter appearing
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Evacuee Trust Properties (Management and Disposal) (Amendment) Ordinance,
1984.
(2) It shall come into force at
once. . .

sections.description:
Amendment of section 4, Act XIII of 1975

ORDINANCE XXXIX OF 1984
ORDINANCE XXXIX OF 1984
EVACUEE TRUST PROPERTIES (MANAGEMENT AND DISPOSAL) (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1984
An Ordinance to amend the Evacuee
Trust Properties (Management and Disposal) Act, 1975
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 21st August, 1984]
Whereas it is expedient to amend
the Evacuee Trust Properties (Manage ment and Disposal) Act, 1975 (XIII of
1975), for the purpose hereinafter appearing
2. Amendment of section 4, Act XIII of 1975.--In the Evacuee Trust
Properties (Management and Disposal) Act, 1975 (XIII of 1975), in section 4, in
subsection (2), for clause (d), the following shall be substituted, namely .
"(d)
to sell, dispose of, or transfer to such person or body, and on such terms and
conditions, as the Federal Government may direct or, with the prior approval of
the Federal Government, make an endowment of, or otherwise manage, evacuee
trust property consistent with the objects of this Act or a scheme or for any
other object approved by the Federal Government ; "
